{{Quote|The assassin was an Iridonian Zabrak. Quite deadly; a martial arts master skilled enough to make Phow Ji look like a drunken Jawa. He had... other skills as well. [...] This assassin stole an item of value from us and fled Coruscant, into orbit.|[[I-5YQ]], to [[Den Dhur]]|<ref name="MIBS">''[[MedStar I: Battle Surgeons]]''</ref>}}
The '''skirmish on Coruscant''' was an incident that took place in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]] just before [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|the Naboo invasion]]. It was sparked after [[Hath Monchar]] from the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] attempted to sell a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that contained information about the imminent invasion since Monchar wanted to profit from it. This did not remain unnoticed as the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] tasked his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] to kill Monchar and those that Monchar spoke to. The Trade Federation, on the other hand, attempted to hire an [[Bounty hunter/Legends|assassin]] that could remove Monchar if he did in fact speak about the invasion to others in order to save face before Sidious (the Federation was unaware that Sidious knew about Monchar's schemes).<ref name="Shadow" />

Monchar attempted to meet with the [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Lorn Pavan]] but Maul killed him and the Federation's hired assassin [[Mahwi Lihnn]] before the pair could conclude their business. Pavan came into possession of the holocron and attempted to sell it off to the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Yanth]]; the Hutt was also killed with Maul in pursuit of Pavan and [[I-5YQ|his droid]] before the [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anoon Bondara]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]] saved the pair. Bondara was killed when he attempted to divert Maul, while Assant sacrificed herself soon after to save Pavan. Pavan later managed to surprise Maul and recover the holocron before [[Cho mai/Legends|losing his hand]] and surrendering it to [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine to give to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] (Pavan was unaware that he delivered it to Sidious himself). Maul killed Pavan in his [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]] on Sidious's orders which kept details about the Naboo invasion secret until it was launched soon after.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|To be sure, desperate times call for desperate measures. Though I regret having to ask this of a person of your stature, I hope you can find it within yourself to once again contact this Mahwi Lihnn, in order that we may satisfactorily resolve the Monchar situation.|Nute Gunray asks Rune Haako to oversee hiring Mahwi Lihnn|<ref name="Shadow" />}}
[[Palpatine/Legends|Darth Sidious]] communicated with the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]] leaders to discuss [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|the blockade]] and continued with their plans despite the fact that [[Hath Monchar]] was absent. Sidious decided to give the impression that he believed that Monchar had taken ill (as [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]] told him) when he knew that Monchar intended to profit from what he knew about the imminent Naboo blockade. He contacted his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]] [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]] (who was sparring with his [[Training droid/Legends|training droids]] on [[Mustafar/Legends|Mustafar]])<ref name="DP">[[Darth Plagueis (novel)|''Darth Plagueis'']]</ref> and ordered him to kill Monchar and to kill those that he spoke to.<ref name="Shadow" />

The [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] [[Lorn Pavan]] and his droid [[I-5YQ]] were able to meet with Monchar in the [[Dewback Inn]] and Pavan was given details about it as well as being told to meet him in [[Kaldani Spires Residential Apartments|his apartment]] within an hour with the funds in hand. Monchar offered to give Pavan a [[Holocron/Legends|holocron]] that contained the information.<ref name="Shadow" />

The [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Darsha Assant]] failed in her [[Mission to the Crimson Corridor|recent mission]] in the [[Crimson Corridor]] and contacted her [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Anoon Bondara]] to inform him about it. He picked her up in an [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and the two proceeded to return to the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in order to inform the [[Jedi High Council]] about the incident. But the two sensed a [[Disturbance in the Force/Legends|disturbance]] and found Pavan and his droid with an unidentified individual in pursuit on a [[Bloodfin/Legends|speeder]] whom the pair identified as a [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]].<ref name="Shadow" />

The Trade Federation, on the other hand, decided to hire an [[Bounty hunter/Legends|assassin]] [[Mahwi Lihnn]] to either kill Monchar (if he spoke out) or to return him to them so as to save face before Sidious. The Federation was unaware that Sidious was aware of what had transpired and had decided to deal with it himself. [[Rune Haako/Legends|Rune Haako]], on Gunray's behalf, contacted Lihnn and she accepted the job to find Monchar on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Shadow" />

==Skirmishes==
{{Quote|If I'm right, there's a Sith out there. He's probably looking for this. He can't be bought off, scared off, or thrown off the trail, and he'll stop at nothing to get it.|Lorn Pavan|<ref name="Shadow" />}}
Maul arrived at the [[Kaldani Spires Residential Apartments]] to seek out Monchar, and confronted him after he killed [[Gorth (Trandoshan)|Gorth]] and his two [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|guards]]. Maul slew Monchar but was forced to confront Lihnn who arrived on the scene; she was killed in the ensuing explosion which also happened to knock Pavan unconscious as he arrived. Pavan recovered the holocron when he woke up and noticed from the scene that a Sith - as Monchar said was involved earlier - had been responsible for the carnage around him. He and I-5YQ fled the scene and hoped to give the information to their [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] contact [[Yanth]] in order to save themselves; but Maul was in pursuit and chased them into the streets after he killed Yanth. Pavan and I-5YQ were saved when Bondara and Assant ushered them into their airspeeder.<ref name="Shadow" />

[[File:AnoonBondara-JATM.jpg|thumb|left|210px|Anoon Bondara leaps from his speeder in order to face Darth Maul and protect his companions.]]
Maul pursued the four on his speeder ''Bloodfin'' and was surprised to see Bondara leap from his airspeeder to confront Maul. That duel saw Bondara die in the explosion he caused when he plunged his [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] into the speeder's power core. Maul managed to escape the explosion and continued to pursue the Padawan and her allies.<ref name="Shadow" />

Pavan and his allies fled into the [[Coruscant Underworld/Legends|underworld]] and ended up in a service conduit to head towards the Jedi Temple. But the three came under attack when [[Cthon/Legends|cthons]] were in the area and this for a time rendered them unconscious. The three soon realized that Maul was still in pursuit and it led to Assant using [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to [[Telekinesis/Legends|push]] them into a [[Carbon-freezing chamber/Legends|carbon-freezing chamber]] while she locked the door behind her to face Maul herself. In their duel she decided to detonate barrels of explosive fuel in an effort to stop him as she recited the [[Jedi Code/Legends|Jedi Code]] in her mind before she died.<ref name="Shadow" />

Pavan and the droid managed to get to the exit and Pavan contacted his old [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] contact [[Tuden Sal]] to get them offworld. But the two noticed that Maul had survived while Maul believed that Pavan was dead. Pavan decided to follow the Sith Lord while I-5YQ gave him a piece of [[Taozin/Legends|taozin]] skin (creatures the group encountered below) to render himself invisible to the Force. Pavan told Sul to deliver his droid to the Jedi Temple while he boarded a space station in orbit and shot two bolts at Maul that stunned him. Pavan recovered the holocron but Maul awoke and [[Cho mai/Legends|sliced off his right hand]].<ref name="Shadow" />

He fled with Maul in pursuit but soon ended up in a solarium in the presence of [[Senate Guard/Legends|Senate Guards]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] Palpatine. Pavan gave him the holocron and told him to give it to the Jedi High Council. [[Kinman Doriana/Legends|Kinman Doriana]] and [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] took Pavan to receive medical treatment while Palpatine provided him with a [[Hotel/Legends|hotel suite]] to recover from his injuries while awaiting a [[Cybernetics/Legends|prosthetic hand]]. Palpatine on the other hand returned to an event he was attending and informed his [[Sith Master/Legends|Sith Master]] [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]] about what had transpired. But Palpatine directed Maul to kill Pavan and the apprentice located and decapitated Pavan to keep the details about the invasion a secret.<ref name="Shadow" /><ref name="DP" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|He died a hero's death, Jax. He died avenging the killing of a Jedi. He died in an attempt to save the Republic from being overthrown. He died in battle with one of the most dangerous assassins in the galaxy.|[[I-5YQ]], about [[Lorn Pavan]]|<ref name="CNIJT">''[[Coruscant Nights I: Jedi Twilight]]''</ref>}}
The Trade Federation's blockade over [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] took place without incident following this and the invasion was fast-tracked after [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Finis Valorum/Legends|Finis Valorum]] decided to send [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|two]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Jedi]] as [[Ambassador/Legends|ambassadors]] to negotiate an end to the standoff.<ref name="Shadow" /><ref name="DP" />

But Bondara and his apprentice's sudden disappearance did not go unnoticed. The Padawan Obi-Wan Kenobi was sent to investigate the matter and determined that Black Sun were involved in their deaths without knowing about the invasion nor the Sith's involvement.<ref name="Shadow" />
